scientific_integrity: The ordinary Fubini period is acknowledged as previously established by Poonen. The claimed new object is the adjacent first-difference sequence and its complete dyadic modular fibers and two-adic closure. Exact two-adic proof covers all k>=7; finite verification is supporting only.
scientific_limitations: Historical equivalent may exist, particularly in uninspected Diagana-Maiga full text; no independent priority certificate.
Only dyadic moduli and adjacent first differences are covered.
title: Complete dyadic residue fibers of adjacent ordered Bell gaps
